description:
What a property, or the properties around it, sold for and when, with price per square foot where a building area is recorded. Recorded deeds in the seven-county Twin Cities metro. Returns the true matching count, up to six example rows, and a link to the dataset's documentation.

Example invocations:
- "What did 1420 Grand Ave, Saint Paul last sell for?"
- "Comparable sales within half a mile of 2900 Hennepin Ave?"

address.description: A street address in the seven-county Minneapolis-St. Paul metro, city after a comma. Omit for the market-wide count.

cut.description: recent: sold since 2019; comps: usable comps only; clean: arms length only; sized: sales with a building area; all: every sale of record. Default recent.

within_ft.description: Radius in feet around `address`. Default 5280 (one mile), capped at 26400.

name: recent_sales_nearby
title: Recent Sales Nearby
